03 / Account-level architecture

The account is
the payment rail.

LATCH is not a merchant escrow. It is the payer’s Stellar contract account enforcing one shared capacity rule.

01Control

Owner signs

Freighter signs a domain-separated authorization payload.

→
02Policy

LATCH account

Default-deny auth permits only exact pay and hold call shapes.

→
03Capacity

Hold registry

Merchant, ceiling, expiry, and backing are verifiable on-chain.

→
04Settlement

Stellar SAC

Only available funds move; capture releases the unused remainder atomically.

Default denyUnknown calls and direct token operations are rejected.
Atomic failureA rejected transaction leaves balance and reservations unchanged.
Honest backingverify_hold stops claiming a guarantee if backing is lost.
04 / Why LATCH

A primitive,
not another wallet.

01

Account-native

The policy lives inside the smart account. Funds never move into a merchant escrow before settlement.

02

Capacity-aware

Every payment sees the same available-versus-reserved truth, closing the double-spend gap by construction.

03

Merchant-verifiable

A merchant can verify guaranteed capacity on-chain, then capture less than the maximum and release the rest.
